title: Agent Discoverability Scorecard
description: Standard-library diagnostics for scholarly web access, machine readability, public index coverage, search-index retrieval and a sampled claims layer for one scholar's work, with a provisional comparison against a resolved Sisk-Leiter-listed OpenAlex cohort. The scorecard reports position X of N with ties and denominators. It is not Agent Engagement (AE), makes no global ranking and produces no composite score. Published baseline: https://wulfkaal.com/agent-engagement/scorecard/
